name: auckland-bioengineering-house
estimated: some heights, with a photograph as a reference; the tower's parapet, and the second stone fin on its north face, placed after the photograph and as high and as deep as the first; and the faces no photograph shows, the tower's drawn after the ones it shows and the lower building's plainly
refs_note: the folder of refs/ that holds the reference views (views.json, masks/), which refine, compare, metrics, sky_mask and the viewer's ?sv= read: refs/photos (gitignored), whose views tools/photo_camera.py writes. Its one photograph is taken from Symonds Street to the building's north-west, about 32 m from the tower's north face, looking up 24 degrees through a lens of about 46 degrees across; its camera is fitted to the tower's top edges and two corners and to three upright edges of its stone fins and its outline, with the principal point at the centre.

building.title: Auckland Bioengineering House (439), University of Auckland
building.note: outline: building 439's outer ring from the main project's campus.json, in the map's frame; it chooses the crop box and the building's own points (frame.near_outline, measure and topview). The site replaces block 439 by its id.

origin.note: the campus origin, as in campus.json; the landmark's local metres = NZTM (EPSG:2193) minus the NZTM of this point, with grid north

door.note: the entrance under the sign on the tower's north face, as the photograph shows it (the campus map records no lobby or entrance in 439, and OpenStreetMap no entrance near it): glass doors under the sloping glazed roof before the face, reached by steps and a ramp from the footpath of Symonds Street. The door is on the landing at the top of the steps, 1.9 m out from the tower's north face (u -15, w 12.5 in the building's frame; u from the doors' foot in the photograph through its fitted camera, w from the LiDAR's ground, which steps down from the landing between w 13 and 14.5). The LiDAR's ground within 1 m: 11 returns, p10/p50/p90 59.738/59.750/59.762 m; the footpath below the steps 59.1 to 59.2 m, falling to 58.8 m 8 m out

frame.method: LiDAR building points (class 6) more than min_above m above the ground and within near_outline m of building.outline
frame.thresholds_note: min_above, tower_above and spine_below were 3, 3 and 40 m above the provisional ground (57.96 m); lowered by 1.79 m with the ground set at the door, so that they pick the same points and the measured frame stays the expected one

ground_note: the LiDAR's ground at the door (step 7, 2026-11-08); the provisional ground was 57.96 m, the median LiDAR ground in the crop box, from which the heights in parts/common.js are measured (its H moves them on to this ground)

light.note: estimated: the photograph is taken on a cloudy day with the sun breaking through, the glass taking the sky's light; the viewer's sun stands at 20 deg round, on the north face's side of the sky, and 40 deg up; the exposure from the building's luma: p10/p50/p90 112/179/224 at 1.4 against the photograph's 113/181/208 (151 at 1.0, 191 at 1.6), with round 1's faces
